messages.subject: R/qtlcharts version 0.9-6
messages.body_plain:
A new version of R/qtlcharts (for interactive graphics) is available on CRAN; see also http://kbroman.org/qtlcharts

Major changes (see https://github.com/kbroman/qtlcharts/blob/master/NEWS.md):
Updated to use D3 version 4 <https://github.com/d3/d3/blob/master/API.md>
Add new tool for exploring pleiotropy for two traits, ipleiotropy()
All charts now can take a caption within chartOpts which will show up as text below the figure. This is intended for stand-alone html files.
iplotScanone now includes a quantitative scale for x-axis in the case of a single chromosome
In iplotScanone and iplotScantwo, in phenotype × genotype plots when switching between markers on the same chromosome, we animate the movement of points
Fixed X chromosome case in iplotScantwo so only relevant two-locus genotypes are shown
karl

messages.subject: R/qtl2 discussion group
messages.body_plain:
I've added a separate R/qtl2 discussion group: https://groups.google.com/d/forum/rqtl2-disc
If you're interested in R/qtl2, please join that group, and please direct questions/discussion about R/qtl2 to that group.

I'll use this rqtl-announce group for announcements about both R/qtl and R/qtl2, and announcements will be cross-posted to the relevant discussion groups, so you don't need to join both the discussion groups and the announcement group.

karl
